exposure: Gestational age at first antenatal visit
Anemia status (anemic, mild anemia, normal Hb%)
outcome: Maternal deaths during labor and early postpartum
cohort: 101 laboring women admitted for delivery in a selected tertiary care hospital in South India from November 10, 2021 to January 20, 2022
finding: The study found a high prevalence of anemia (58.4% at first antenatal visit) and underweight (36.6%) among pregnant women, and a high rate of caesarean section delivery (50.5%).
mod_finding: Emergency caesarean section delivery was statistically significant among underweight women.
